title: Specialised Investment Funds and other newer products
objectives: Describe the Specialised Investment Fund and its entry rules.
Explain solution-oriented schemes, FMPs and segregated portfolios.
body_md:
## Specialised Investment Funds (SIF)

A **SIF** sits between a mutual fund and a PMS: it can use strategies such as **long-short** within limits, with a higher minimum ticket (**₹10 lakh per investor across SIF strategies**, verify) and separate investment-strategy names. Distributors must follow the current SEBI conditions for selling it.

## Other scheme types

| Scheme | Key point |
|---|---|
| **Solution-oriented** (retirement, children) | Lock-in of about **5 years** or until retirement age or age 18 |
| **Fixed maturity plan (FMP)** | Closed-ended debt scheme; exit only at maturity or on the exchange |
| **Interval fund** | Opens for transactions only at set intervals |
| **ELSS** | Equity scheme with a **3-year lock-in** for the old tax regime deduction |
| **Segregated portfolio** | A side pocket for a defaulted or downgraded paper so other investors can exit at a clean NAV |

## Newer conduct points

- Match the product to the client, and do not sell a complex product to a client who cannot explain it back.
- Disclose lock-in, exit load and risk class each time.
- A new category does not mean better returns.

## Before recommending

Read the **SID** for the investment strategy, risk and exit terms.

> **Exam tip:** Retirement and children's schemes carry a lock-in of about five years; FMPs are closed-ended.
example: A segregated portfolio holds a downgraded bond. Investors keep units in it, while the main scheme runs on with the rest of the assets.
say: This product has a lock-in, so I want to be sure you will not need the money.
Let us read the SID together.
never: A new fund type is better than the old ones.
You can exit an FMP any day at NAV.

check.q: A segregated portfolio is used to:
o: Isolate a defaulted or downgraded security

check.q: The lock-in of a typical retirement solution-oriented scheme is about:
check.why: About five years, or until retirement age.
